name: STM32G431 devkit demo (USB-C + LDO + SWD + I2C)
description: Stage-1 pilot of the board definition flow (REQUIREMENTS §25): five PartReel blocks composed into one root schematic. USB D+/D- to PA12/PA11, Cortex debug to SWD + SWO on PB3, I2C1 pull-ups on PB7/PA15. Power rails (+5V/+3V3/GND) merge via global power symbols inside the blocks.
